extraction_notes: The datasheet covers B0520WS through B0540WS; tabulated values were taken only from the B0530WS column for the requested target and manufacturer.

The B0530WS absolute maximum ratings are VRRM = 30 V, VRMS = 21 V, VDC = 30 V, IF(AV) = 0.5 A, IFSM = 5.5 A at t = 8.3 ms half-sine wave, PD = 200 mW, Tj = -55 to +125 degC, TSTG = -55 to +150 degC, and RthetaJ-A = 500 degC/W; the strict extraction schema has no dedicated fields for these ratings.
The B0530WS electrical table provides maximum forward voltage at IF = 0.1 A and 0.5 A; the IF = 1.0 A entry is a dash for B0530WS and was not converted into a point.

The B0530WS table lists maximum reverse current of 0.080 mA at VR = 15 V and 0.5 mA at VR = 30 V. The reverse_current object records the VR = 30 V row; the other row is retained here because the schema permits only one reverse-current object.
The CT table entry is 170 pF at VR = 0 V and f = 1 MHz. The row has no explicit maximum or typical qualifier, so source_kind is recorded as typical rather than asserting a limit.

Fig. 1, Fig. 2, and Fig. 3 points are direct approximate axis read-offs from the plotted traces, with no interpolation or invented intermediate points. The plots are family-level figures in a datasheet titled B0520WS THRU B0540WS and are not separately keyed by variant.
Fig. 2 has visibly non-monotonic printed x-axis labels around 15 V and 20 V. Curve x values use the physical linear 0-30 V plot span and preserve the plotted reverse-voltage axis semantics.
No reverse-recovery-time or breakdown-characteristic data are published for B0530WS in the examined pages, so reverse_recovery, breakdown_voltage, and breakdown_current are null.
